budget_items.topic: Clause 41C elderly exemption limits and abatement (historical, last acted on 2006)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The minutes record the 2006 elderly exemption income limits and abatement amount: the single-person limit, the married-couple limit, and the abatement increase.
budget_items.quote: the elderly exemption income limits for a single person were $24,000 and married couple were $30,000. the abatement was raised from $600 to $750.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: John Rabbitt wants to move forward with a range of $750 to $1,000 and change the age limit; no decision was recorded.
budget_items.quote: john rabbitt wants to move forward with $750 to $1,000 and change the age limit to be consistent with what all other communities are doing.
